# Reviewed helper model fixtures

These two historical public helpers are inputs for the existing
static inspection model. The pipeline fixture uses a placeholder for its AAB
default line; the reader reuses that unchanged line from the existing production
helper. The pinned historical digest checks the reconstructed bytes. No resource
name is copied into a new fixture. The model infers the old QPK source import precedence
and daily shell-child call graph. Reading the current live source in these
fixtures would test a different program against those historical expectations.

The current helpers use the Monitor import root and a selected-venv direct daily
builder instead. They intentionally remain unreviewed/unknown in this inspector;
`test_current_helpers_remain_unknown_without_a_reviewed_model` checks that no
interpreter or import proof is inferred. This fixture repair does not qualify the
current helpers, update the production hash allowlist, or establish runtime
adoption. Historical security and snapshot assertions remain enabled.
